title: Warm Fish Stew
description: A hearty fish stew made with Mediterranean flavors, served warm and perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the fish fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Add the chopped tomato, Mediterranean seasoning, lemon juice, and white wine (if using).
Pour in the water and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
